summary: Full backend + frontend testing of AI Competitor Intelligence app. Backend: 12/13 pytest tests pass (auth incl. cookie+Bearer, dashboard, competitor create+live scrape+GPT analyze on example.com, our-product analyze setting has_real_product=true, insights/generate returning executive_summary+swot+insights+actions, demo load/clear). The 1 'failure' is a test-assertion issue not a real bug: PATCH /api/actions/{id} returns {ok: true} (status update succeeds, just no full object returned). Frontend: Login with admin@example.com/admin123 works cleanly, navigates to dashboard. All 6 score cards render (Overall 74, Price 82, Features 74, Value 78, Market 62, Innovation 76). Sidebar nav (Dashboard/Competitors/Compare/Insights/SWOT/Settings) all functional. Compare page shows Radar, Positioning scatter with X/Y selectors, Score Comparison bar. Competitors page lists 7 demo competitors with Demo labels + status badges + action icons. All required data-testids (input-email, input-password, auth-submit, nav-*, add-competitor-btn, generate-insights-btn, export-pdf-btn, toggle-demo-btn) are present. Executive summary + AI insights load. No page reload/input-wipe issue observed.

minor.issue: Returns {ok: true} instead of the updated action object; harder for clients to sync state without an extra GET. Update itself works.

ui_bugs.issue: React 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' warning in console (missing key on <tr>). Minor - doesn't break UI.

issues: Bubble labels overlap when multiple competitors cluster in same quadrant (e.g. Slack/Samsung/Microsoft Teams/Ola Electric all overlap at high Price/Features).

action_items: Optional: return the full updated action doc from PATCH /api/actions/{id} (currently returns {ok: true}).
Optional: add unique React key to competitor table rows in Competitors.js to silence console warning.
Optional: improve label spacing / add tooltips on Competitive Positioning scatter to reduce overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth cleanly supports both Bearer token (localStorage) and httpOnly cookie — verified both work against /api/auth/me.
Live scraping + GPT-5.4 analyze on example.com and stripe.com returned real data with 'Not publicly available' where appropriate (no fabrication).
Server-side weighted overall score computed correctly (verified visually: 74 baseline with demo data).
No hardcoded URLs found in tested paths — REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL respected.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed users via /api/auth/register and TEST_Example competitor (cleaned up). No permanent seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py — run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py -v. Login: admin@example.com/admin123. LLM analyze/insights calls take 10-40s; timeouts are set at 180s. Frontend data-testids are all present as documented; no input-wipe/WDS reload issue observed during test run.
